title: 心理学統計法
subtitle: Psychological Statistics
teachers:
TOKUOKA Masaru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Statistical analysis is required for psychological research with high generalizability. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to run statistical tests and to understand the results of the tests precisely.
advice:
The class proceeds with lectures on the basic theory of psychological statistics and practical training of statistical analyses that include calculations with real data using Microsoft Excel and R. Students are expected to understand the basics of psychological statistics and learn the method of statistical analysis to avoid misuse of statistical analysis and misinterpretation of the results of analyses.
Note that the course flow can be changed according to other closely related courses such as “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments.”

This subject is subject to the course credit system.

activityGoals.body: Ability to decide which statistical analyses are appropriate for the data acquired in experiments and surveys.
Ability to run statistical analyses with appropriate methods and to interpret the results in appropriate ways.
Ability to understand the selection, computation, and interpretation of descriptive statistics.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1)	Calculate the data acquired in experiments, surveys and observations precisely and interpret their features.
2)	Decide which statistical analyses are appropriate for the experimental design and run the statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
3)	Interpret the results of the analyses and make a conclusion according to the purpose of the experiment.
achievementLevels.standard:
1)	Calculate the data acquired in experiments, surveys and observations precisely and interpret their features.
2)	Decide which statistical analyses are appropriate for the experimental design and run the statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
3)	Understand why statistical analyses are required in psychological research and explain the reason.

              Statistical analysis is required for psychological research with high generalizability. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to run statistical tests and to understand the results of the tests precisely.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The class proceeds with lectures on the basic theory of psychological statistics and practical training of statistical analyses that include calculations with real data using Microsoft Excel and R. Students are expected to understand the basics of psychological statistics and learn the method of statistical analysis to avoid misuse of statistical analysis and misinterpretation of the results of analyses.
Note that the course flow can be changed according to other closely related courses such as “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments.”

This subject is subject to the course credit system.
